atoms.H: The start of everything. Most abundant, most simple.
atoms.O: Essential for life. Makes up about 65% of the human body.
atoms.C: The backbone of organic chemistry. Forms the basis of all living things.
atoms.N: A key component of proteins and nucleic acids.
atoms.S: Important for the structure of proteins.
atoms.P: Crucial for energy storage and transfer.
atoms.Cl: A halogen gas at room temperature. Found in table salt.
atoms.Na: A soft, silvery-white, highly reactive metal.
atoms.K: A soft, silvery-white, highly reactive metal.
atoms.Ca: A soft, silvery-white, highly reactive metal.
atoms.Mg: A lightweight, silvery-white, highly reactive metal.
atoms.Br: A volatile, reddish-brown liquid at room temperature.
atoms.I: A black, crystalline solid at room temperature.
